newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: EA-Generali group says ups Creditanstalt bid.
newsitem.headline: EA-Generali group says ups Creditanstalt bid.

text.p: Insurer EA-Generali, which leads an international group of bidders for Austrian selloff candidate Creditanstalt said on Wednesday it had increased its offer for the bank but gave no details.
"We have decided to improve our offer," EA-Generali chief executive Dietrich Karner told a news conference.

EA-Generali and its partners, which include savings bank Die Erste, Germany's Commerzbank and Banca Commercialie Italiana, originally offered a total of 13.8 billion schillings ($1.3 billion) for the state's 19.9 million shares in the bank and wanted to sell about a quarter of those on the market.
Rival Bank Austria has bid some 16.8 billion schillings for the entire bank stake.
Karner said it had not been the consortium's aim to outbid Bank Austria. "It was not our goal to outdo Bank Austria, we were led by purely economic considerations," he said.

Bank Austria's supervisory board is due to meet on Thursday to decide on a possible adjustment of its own bid ahead of a Friday deadline set by Finance Minister Viktor Klima. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
